title: Strange noise instead of alarm sound
symptom: When the phone is in sleep and an alarm for low or high glucose activates with the default alarm sound, it sometimes plays a strange 'electronic noise' instead of the actual alarm sound.
fix: One user reported that switching off the 'Import Sounds' setting in Settings -> Inter-app settings (in AndroidAPS) resolved the issue, but this is not confirmed by the maintainers.
evidence_quote: There is a setting called **Import Sounds** in the Settings -> Inter-app settings menu. I switched this off and haven't heard it since.
